shots.seen: A man in black clothes walks from behind along a dark path with yellow markings towards white monolithic gates, accompanied by people in colorful robes under a starry dusk sky.
The man in black and others in robes walk forward towards the camera alongside a yellow path and simple grey buildings.
Seen from behind from the knees up, the man in black walks with robed figures down a street lined with plain grey box buildings.
Seen from behind from the hips up, the man in black walks with robed companions towards a calm body of water under a starry sky.
The man in black is seen full-body from behind walking up wide dark steps towards boxy buildings with glowing yellow windows.
Seen from the hips up from behind, the man in black walks down steps overlooking a city and bay under strings of overhead lights.
Seen from behind from the knees up, the man in black stands in shallow water with robed figures raising their hands beneath a rainbow in the night sky.
Seen from behind from the knees up, the man in black stands on a ledge overlooking a sprawling boxy city with lit windows and robed people gathered below.

overall: The cel-shaded cartoon style is very consistent across all shots, though the strict full-body third-person view frequently crops in to medium shots from the hips or knees up (and reverses angle in Shot 2). The biggest weakness is the rudimentary, untextured grey-box architecture that fails to capture the rich poetic imagery of the narration.
